title: scada-fault-bench: an open benchmark for fault detection in wind and PV SCADA data
description:
Faults with a known time, device and size are injected into clean stretches of open wind and PV datasets in the scada-schema format (Kelmarsh, Penmanshiel, Hill of Towie, NREL PVDAQ); detectors are scored by one evaluation (event and row metrics, detection delay, false alarm hours per year, sensitivity to the size of the fault) with block-bootstrap confidence intervals, and on real labelled faults of CARE to Compare. Simple baselines and reference methods from other repositories are included. The injected faults are a signal-level model, not recorded failures; the results describe this benchmark only. The package does not redistribute the datasets; CARE to Compare is licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.

Project page: https://kwwaleszczynski-del.github.io/scada-fault-bench/
